content.concept_description: A player struggles and methodically slides colored and checkerboard lego-style blocks into exit arrows to clear the board.
content.why_it_works: The tactile block-sliding mechanic paired with satisfying crunch sound effects and challenging spatial layout hooks viewers into wanting to solve it themselves.

visuals.notable_objects: Lego-style studded puzzle blocks, arrow slider slots

emotions.emotional_arc: Intrigue and slight frustration trying to maneuver blocks, yielding to satisfaction as pathways are cleared.

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:00 - 'I can't reach colors..', 00:49 - 'why is this so hard?!'

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Sliding studded blocks in horizontal and vertical directions toward matching colored or open exit chutes.

chapterization.chapter_description: Initial puzzle board is presented with text highlighting blocked colored pieces.
Player slowly crushes checkerboard blocks through exits to free the long orange block.
A new, more intricate puzzle featuring a green 'I' shape surrounded by monochrome blocks begins.
